description: Drags from one resolved source to a resolved target, coordinate, or bounded offset within the same document.

pageId.description: Page ID containing the drag source and destination.

selector.description: Fallback CSS selector for the drag source.

id.description: Preferred canonical element ID for the drag source.

x.description: Fallback source X coordinate in CSS pixels.

y.description: Fallback source Y coordinate in CSS pixels.

toSelector.description: CSS selector for the destination. Without toOffset, the drop point defaults to the destination center.

toId.description: Canonical destination ID. Without toOffset, the drop point defaults to the destination center.

toOffset.description: Normalized point inside the destination (0–1). Use y=0.2/0.8 when upper/lower drop zones change the result.

x.description: Normalized horizontal drop position inside the destination, from 0 to 1.

y.description: Normalized vertical drop position inside the destination, from 0 to 1.

dx.description: Relative horizontal drag offset when not using an explicit destination. If omitted while dy is provided, defaults to 0.

dy.description: Relative vertical drag offset when not using an explicit destination. If omitted while dx is provided, defaults to 0.

purpose.description: Describe the intended drag effect. Keep source and destination in the same document, and prefer canonical element IDs when targeting an element.

source.description: Resolved drag source identity or point.

destination.description: Resolved drag destination identity or point.

resolvedBy.description: Resolution mode used for the drag endpoints.

distance.description: Drag path distance in CSS pixels.

completed.description: Whether the native drag and drop operation completed.

resolutionSource.description: Target resolution route used by the action.

observation.description: Facts directly observed by the Action or returned by its declared result schema.

suggested_prompt.description: Guidance to re-observe current state and choose the next operation.

destination.description: Resolved drag destination identity or point.

distance.description: Drag path distance in CSS pixels.

completed.description: Whether the native drag and drop operation completed.

data.description: Validated business result returned by the Action.

message.description: Concise public explanation for the failure code.

observation.description: Directly observed failure fact; it must not infer an unobserved browser side effect.

suggested_prompt.description: Guidance to re-observe current state and choose the next operation.

details.description: Only fields listed by the public error definition detailFields are returned; private execution diagnostics are omitted.
